trust: Local desktop preview. Extensions are trusted, unsandboxed code. Review the source and requested capabilities before enabling one.

plugins_subtitle: Shared tools and accounts for your agents.
executor_intro: Connect Executor to use the same tools and service accounts with agents in local and cloud workspaces.
executor_failed: Could not reach Executor. Refresh to retry.
executor_key_help: Create a personal API key in Executor. Zuse stores it on this runtime; it is never included in chat prompts. Use the same Executor account on your other environments to share connections.
executor_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect Executor from this environment? Further plugin calls will be blocked. Accounts and tools in Executor will remain available on other environments.
executor_all_tools: All tools allowed by my account
executor_scope_help: Toolkits limit which connections and actions agents can use. Manage account permissions and approvals in Executor. Start a new chat after enabling plugins or changing the toolkit.
executor_no_account: No connected account. Connect one in Executor.
executor_empty: No matching tools. Add an integration in Executor, then refresh.
